attractions.name: Leteku Pukhuri
attractions.description: A peaceful lake and pilgrimage site, revered as the birthplace of the Vaishnavite saint Sri Madhabdev. A lovely half-day outing.

attractions.name: Narua Satra, Dhakuakhana
attractions.description: A historic Satra founded by Damodar Aata, and a respected centre of Assam's Vaishnavite culture.

attractions.name: Shri Basudev Than
attractions.description: One of Assam's old temples, visited by devotees throughout the year.

attractions.name: Phulani Than
attractions.description: An important holy site in the district, easily combined with a scenic countryside drive.

attractions.name: Pabha (Milroy) Wildlife Sanctuary
attractions.description: A small protected forest established for the wild water buffalo, and a quiet stop for nature lovers and birdwatchers.

attractions.name: Subansiri River
attractions.description: A major tributary of the Brahmaputra, with wide channels, river islands and green banks close to town.

attractions.name: Rahdhala Pukhuri
attractions.description: A water body in North Lakhimpur town, named the state's best in the Amrit Sarovar Mahotsav.

attractions.name: Gandhi Park
attractions.description: A municipal park in town with slides, swings and a mini toy train, popular with families.
